title: Successful cryopreservation of human ovarian cortex tissues using supercooling
protocol: Surgically remove human ovarian tissues from a female patient with cervical cancer before chemotherapy and/or radiation therapy.
Freeze human ovarian cortex tissues using the conventional method or supercooling procedures.
Use three supercooling machines for supercooling processes.
Utilize Program freezer to freeze samples according to the conventional program.
Store frozen samples in a Conventional Liquid nitrogen tank.
Reconstitute human ovary in Leibovitz L-15 medium.
Dissect human ovarian cortex to obtain 40 small pieces (10 × 10 mm).
Incubate the pieces for 30 min in cryoprotective solution at 4.0°C.
Place each piece of human ovarian cortex in a 2-ml vial containing 1.4 ml of cryoprotectant solution.
Start supercooling procedure from 4.0°C to –5.0°C at 1.0°C/min using supercooling machines.
Soak for 20 min in the supercooled state under a variable magnetic field (2kHz, 0.3mT).
Manually seed and continue cooling from –5.0°C to –40.0°C at 1.0°C/min.
Cool rapidly from –40.0°C to –140.0°C at 10.0°C/min.
Plunge into liquid nitrogen for cryopreservation.
Thaw vials by placing them at room temperature for 2 min.
Place thawed vials in water at 25.0°C for 2 min.
Wash the human ovarian tissue stepwise in progressively lower concentrations of cryoprotectant solution (1.5, 1, 0.5 and 0 mol/l) for 5 min each.
Soak the human ovarian tissue at 4.0°C for 20 minutes.
Transfer the tissue to a supercooling machine and soak in a supercooled state at –5.0°C for 20 minutes.
Move the pieces of tissue to a conventional program freezer.
Cool the tissue at 1.0°C/min from -40.0°C to –140.0°C within the conventional program freezer.
Plunge the tissue into liquid nitrogen.
Thaw the tissue on the day of the experimental procedure by placing it in room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place the thawed tissue in water at 25.0°C for 2 minutes.
Wash the tissue stepwise in progressively lower concentrations of cryoprotectant solution (1.5, 1, 0.5 and 0 mol/l) for 5 minutes each.
Transport human ovarian tissue rapidly to the laboratory in Leibovitz L-15 medium.
Dissect the human ovary carefully to obtain small pieces (10 × 10 mm).
Incubate the dissected pieces for 30 min in a cryoprotective solution (Leibovitz medium supplemented with 1.5 M dimethylsulphoxide).
Start the freezing procedure at 4.0°C, cooling at 2.0°C/min to –7.0°C.
Soak for 10 min at –7.0°C.
Manually seed the sample.
Cool from –7.0°C to –40.0°C at a rate of 0.3°C/min.
Cool from –40.0°C to –140.0°C at a rate of 10.0°C/min.
Plunge into liquid nitrogen.
Thaw the tissue by placing vials at room temperature for 2 min.
Place thawed vials in water at 25.0°C for 2 min.
Wash human ovarian tissue stepwise for 5 min each with cryoprotectant solutions at concentrations of 1.5, 1, 0.5 and 0 mol/l.
Investigate the expressions of human oocyte marker genes within human ovarian cortex tissues by RT-PCR.
Assess the presence of indicated mRNA in total RNA samples using conventional RT-PCR.
Prepare cDNA from total RNA samples using a SuperScript® VILO™ cDNA Synthesis Kit.
Analyze gene expression in total RNA samples using Platinum Taq polymerase.
Fix human ovarian cortex tissue in 4% PFA.
Embed fixed tissue in paraffin and section it (6-μm thickness).
Perform high temperature antigen retrieval using 0.01 M sodium citrate buffer (pH 6.0).
Cool sections after antigen retrieval.
Wash sections with PBS following antigen retrieval.
Block sections for 1 h at 20 °C using TNK buffer containing either normal goat serum or normal donkey serum.
Incubate sections overnight at 4 °C with a 1:100 dilution of primary antibody in TNK buffer.
Wash sections with PBS after incubation with primary antibodies.
Incubate sections for 30 min at 20 °C with a 1:500 dilution of secondary antibodies conjugated to Alexa Fluor.
For YBX2 expression, detect primary antibody using goat anti-rabbit biotinylated IgG for 1 h at 20 °C.
React sections with streptavidin-conjugated Alexa Fluor 568 after detecting primary antibody for YBX2.
Wash sections with PBS following secondary antibody incubation or detection of YBX2.
Cover slip sections using Vectashield containing DAPI.

Mix pairs of cortical cubes with or without bpV(pic) at a concentration of 100 mM for 24 hours in MEM-α medium containing 10% human serum albumin, 1% antibiotic/antimycotic solution, and 0.3 IU/mL FSH.
Transplant human oocytes into the oviduct after treatment.
Grow transplanted oocytes within the oviduct for 24 weeks.
Count follicles only when a dark-staining nucleolus is observed within the nucleus of the oocytes to avoid recounting the same follicle.
